events.event_hazard: torrential rainstorm, river flooding, and landslide
key_impacts: Rivers rose at night and swept away houses along their banks.
In Fenadesal Sur, 14 inches of rain fell in four hours, turning the Acelhuate River into a torrent that ripped away bridges and obliterated homes.
In Fenadesal Sur, 30 houses were destroyed and more than 100 damaged; about 300 residents evacuated with no lives lost.
Heavy rains triggered a major landslide in Verapaz; several riverside communities required evacuation.
